location_scope: Rajshahi pilot; exact BR11 transplanting evidence for Rajshahi
rajshahi_location_note: BR11 study implemented in Rajshahi; Rajshahi BAMIS regional calendar also available.
window_basis: Rajshahi BR11 study: 10-24 July recommended; transplanting after 24 July increased irrigation demand and reduced yield.
local_favorable_temperature_text: BAMIS: germination >=10 C; vegetative about 22-25 C; later stages about 23-27 C; soil temperature above 16 C.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BR11 Rajshahi/Pabna/Kushtia study sites: clay loam to sandy loam; pH 7.0-8.5. Treat as study-site context, not all Rajshahi soils.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Rajshahi BAMIS calendar includes stage-specific heavy-rain/wet-spell, wind and low-temperature warnings; use calendar source, not EcoCrop, for event risk.
local_water_metric_note: Sum of BAMIS stage-wise 'normal water requirement' values (76+120+190+145+100 mm); not identical to irrigation requirement.
irrigation_guidance: Rainfed T. Aman may still need supplemental irrigation when rainfall is delayed/insufficient; BR11 study found later transplanting increased reproductive-stage irrigation demand.
yield_basis: 5.0 t/ha threshold used in Rajshahi study; BR11 national average 5.5 t/ha.
rotation_family_rule: Poaceae/cereal; consecutive Poaceae can be penalized as a diversity proxy, subject to local agronomy.
rotation_note: BR11 is long-duration. A separate short-duration Aman profile (e.g. Binadhan-7) could be added later if you want earlier field release.
algorithm_use_note: Use 07-10..07-24 as recommended transplanting window for this BR11 Rajshahi profile; do not treat 07-24 as biological impossibility.
research_notes: Exact Rajshahi timing evidence is unusually strong for this row.

location_scope: North-West Bangladesh evidence includes Tanore; Rajshahi BAMIS regional calendar
rajshahi_location_note: North-West field study included Tanore; local BAMIS calendar exists for Rajshahi Region.
window_basis: PLOS NW study reports BRRI recommended BRRI dhan28 transplanting 25 Dec-10 Jan; fields in NW were observed from late Dec through end Feb, with delay reducing yield.
local_favorable_temperature_text: Rajshahi BAMIS Boro calendar provides stage-specific temperature guidance; use local calendar for event checks.
local_soil_or_variety_note: Boro is irrigation-dependent in NW Bangladesh; irrigation access strongly affects yield.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Use Rajshahi BAMIS Boro calendar for stage-specific heavy-rain, wet-spell, wind and temperature warnings.
local_water_metric_note: Sum of BAMIS stage-wise 'normal water requirement' values; not identical to irrigation requirement.
irrigation_guidance: High irrigation dependence; NW study notes March-April groundwater limitations can delay irrigation and reduce yield.
yield_basis: PLOS NW study cites attainable yield about 6.0 t/ha for BRRI dhan28.
rotation_family_rule: Poaceae/cereal; repeated rice/cereal sequence can be penalized only as a transparent diversity proxy.
rotation_note: Late transplanting is possible in observed NW practice, but yield risk increases; do not equate end-February with a safe optimum.
algorithm_use_note: SAFE inside 12-25..01-10; after 01-10 and through 02-28 can be treated as COMPRESSED/LATE for prototype; do not label biologically impossible without expert validation.
research_notes: Preferred window is BRRI dhan28-specific; supported late bound is observed NW practice, not a recommended endpoint.

location_scope: Rajshahi Region; variety suitable across Bangladesh except southern saline areas
rajshahi_location_note: BAMIS has a Rajshahi Region wheat calendar; BARI Gom-33 is nationally suitable outside southern saline zone.
window_basis: BWMRI: ideal sowing 15-30 Nov. BAMIS: can be extended to 15-20 Dec.
local_favorable_temperature_text: Rajshahi BAMIS: around 25 C favorable; mean 15-20 C during growth; maximum cardinal about 30-32 C.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BARI Gom-33 is early and heat tolerant; blast resistant and zinc enriched.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Rajshahi BAMIS includes stage-specific rain/wet-spell risks, drought around 20 days, max temperature >30 C and min temperature <15 C warnings.
local_water_metric_note: Sum of Rajshahi BAMIS phase-wise normal-water values (47+128+77+137+39 mm); not identical to irrigation requirement.
irrigation_guidance: BAMIS: generally 2-3 irrigations; first 17-21 DAS, second 50-55 DAS, third about 75-80 DAS.
yield_basis: Official BWMRI BARI Gom-33 yield range.
rotation_family_rule: Poaceae/cereal; repeated cereal family may receive diversity penalty if agronomically appropriate alternatives exist.
rotation_note: Good Window Guard profile because exact preferred and supported-late sowing windows are available.
algorithm_use_note: SAFE through 11-30 when other constraints pass; 12-01..12-20 can be modeled as COMPRESSED/LATE; >12-20 is outside the documented supported window, not a universal biological impossibility.
research_notes: One of the strongest decision-ready rows.

location_scope: Bangladesh variety + Rajshahi Region BAMIS calendar
rajshahi_location_note: Use Rajshahi BAMIS calendar for regional weather context; BINA variety page provides variety timing and soil traits.
window_basis: BINA: last week Oct to mid-Nov is suitable; satisfactory yield possible through third week Dec because variety is late-sowing capable. Encoded dates are calendar approximations of those phrases.
local_favorable_temperature_text: Rajshahi BAMIS: about 15-27 C favorable; soil temperature about 13-25 C.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BINA: grows best from sandy loam to clay loam; Binasarisha-9 tolerates temporary waterlogging and 6-8 dS/m salinity.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Rajshahi BAMIS: heavy rain >50 mm/day is a warning; stage-specific drought, wind and temperature warnings also apply.
irrigation_guidance: Use BINA/BAMIS local guidance; do not substitute FAO bean/other-oilseed water values as mustard-specific values.
rotation_family_rule: Brassicaceae oilseed; provides family diversification after rice/cereals.
rotation_note: Useful short-duration Rabi option after Aman; late-sowing tolerance makes it useful in Rotation GPS.
algorithm_use_note: Treat 10-25 and 11-15 as approximations for textual week/mid-month guidance. 11-16..12-21 can be modeled as late/compressed, not equally optimal.
research_notes: 10-25 and 12-21 are encoding conventions for 'last week October' and 'third week December'; keep date_precision.

location_scope: Rajshahi explicitly listed suitable by BINA; Rajshahi BAMIS calendar
rajshahi_location_note: BINA explicitly lists Rajshahi, Chapainawabganj and Natore among suitable areas for Binamasur-9.
window_basis: BINA: optimum sowing from last week of October to second week of November; encoded as 10-25..11-14.
local_favorable_temperature_text: Rajshahi BAMIS: roughly 10-21.15 C early and about 14-25 C during later reproductive stages.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BINA: loam and clay-loam; select high and well-drained land. Rajshahi is explicitly suitable.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Use Rajshahi BAMIS lentil calendar for stage-specific rain, temperature and wet-spell warnings.
irrigation_guidance: No exact lentil-specific seasonal water total inserted here; use local agronomic guidance rather than an analog crop value.
yield_basis: BINA variety profile: average about 2.25 t/ha and yield potential about 2.40 t/ha.
rotation_family_rule: Fabaceae legume; may contribute biological nitrogen fixation when well nodulated; use as a soil-health proxy, not a guaranteed N-credit.
rotation_note: Strong diversification candidate after cereals; local suitability is explicitly supported.
algorithm_use_note: Use variety duration and the approximate 10-25..11-14 optimum window. Do not create an unsupported hard latest date.
research_notes: BINA sources differ slightly on duration (99-104 vs 100-105 days); this row uses the current Binamasur-9 page's 100-105-day range and the BINA variety PDF for yield.

location_scope: Rajshahi regional BAMIS Kharif-I calendar; exact modeled sowing optimum comes from South-central Bangladesh
rajshahi_location_note: BAMIS has a Rajshahi Kharif-I green gram calendar. Exact 15-25 March optimum was modeled/validated in the South-central zone, so transferability to Rajshahi is medium rather than high.
window_basis: PLOS APSIM study: BARI Mung-6 optimum 15-25 March in South-central Bangladesh; Rajshahi BAMIS confirms local Kharif-I crop calendar but not this exact day window.
local_favorable_temperature_text: BAMIS generic mung: optimum growth about 19-31 C; sow when minimum temperature >15 C; <10 C minimum or >30 C maximum can inhibit germination. Rajshahi Kharif-I calendar provides stage-specific context.
local_relative_humidity_text: BAMIS generic mung: about 60-85% RH favorable.
local_soil_or_variety_note: Mung bean is relatively drought tolerant; cloudy weather and waterlogging reduce growth/yield.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Rajshahi Kharif-I BAMIS calendar includes stage-specific heavy-rain and wind warnings; avoid waterlogging.
irrigation_guidance: No exact mung-specific FAO seasonal water range inserted; use local/BARI guidance.
yield_basis: Peer-reviewed variety table citing BARI (2017): BARI Mung-6 1.5-1.6 t/ha.
rotation_family_rule: Fabaceae legume; family diversification and biological N fixation are positive soil-health proxies if nodulation/management are adequate.
rotation_note: Short duration makes it valuable for Rotation GPS and multi-crop sequences.
algorithm_use_note: Do not present 03-15..03-25 as Rajshahi-validated exact window; label as Bangladesh modeled optimum supported by a Rajshahi regional Kharif-I calendar.
research_notes: Use confidence flag in UI/logic because exact sowing window source is not Rajshahi-specific.

location_scope: Barind/Rajshahi-focused variety + Rajshahi BAMIS Rabi calendar
rajshahi_location_note: BWMRI explicitly says the variety is especially suitable for drought-prone Barind areas; Rajshahi BAMIS Rabi maize calendar available.
window_basis: BAMIS package: Rabi maize sowing 15 Oct-15 Nov.
local_favorable_temperature_text: Rajshahi BAMIS: germination >=10 C; vegetative about 22-25 C; reproductive/later stages about 23-27 C; soil temp >16 C.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BARI Hybrid Maize-13 is medium drought tolerant and specifically suited to drought-prone Barind and other dry areas.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Rajshahi BAMIS Rabi maize calendar includes stage-specific heavy-rain/wet-spell and wind warnings; waterlogging should be avoided.
local_water_metric_note: Sum of BAMIS stage-wise normal-water values; not identical to irrigation requirement.
irrigation_guidance: BAMIS: irrigate about 15-20, 30-35, 60-70 and 85-89 DAS; avoid waterlogging. BARI Hybrid Maize-13 can produce under one pre-flowering irrigation in drought conditions, but with lower yield than normal irrigation.
yield_basis: Official BWMRI: 8.1-8.5 t/ha with one irrigation under drought; 10.0-11.1 t/ha under normal irrigation.
rotation_family_rule: Poaceae/cereal; repeated cereal family may receive diversity penalty.
rotation_note: Longer BARI Hybrid Maize-13 duration (140-145 d) differs from generic Rajshahi calendar duration (112 d); decision engine should use the selected variety duration, not the generic duration.
algorithm_use_note: Use 10-15..11-15 for Rabi sowing and 140-145 d for this selected variety. Keep the 112-d regional generic duration only as contextual reference.
research_notes: Variety is particularly relevant to the Barind/Rajshahi pilot.

location_scope: Northern Bangladesh planting evidence + Rajshahi BAMIS regional calendar
rajshahi_location_note: Rajshahi is in northern/north-western Bangladesh; BAMIS has a Rajshahi Region potato calendar. The first-week-November optimum is reported for northern Bangladesh.
window_basis: Peer-reviewed multi-location Bangladesh study: optimal planting in northern area during first week of November; encoded as 11-01..11-07.
local_favorable_temperature_text: BAMIS threshold: planting temperature about 18-20 C; optimal soil temperature about 15-18 C; tuber formation declines above 25 C and is inhibited around 29 C.
local_soil_or_variety_note: BAMIS: soil moisture around 65-80% field capacity is favorable; potato is moderately salt sensitive.
weather_risk_threshold_text: Use Rajshahi BAMIS potato calendar/threshold for rain, temperature, moisture and disease-related weather risk.
local_water_metric_note: BAMIS gives rainfall/moisture guidance; FAO seasonal crop-water range is kept separately.
irrigation_guidance: High water sensitivity; avoid both water stress and waterlogging. Use local irrigation scheduling rather than converting NASA rainfall directly to irrigation need.
yield_basis: Peer-reviewed Bangladesh variety stability study reports BARI Alu-41 mean productivity about 38-54 t/ha.
rotation_family_rule: Solanaceae/tuber; strong family diversification from rice/wheat/maize.
rotation_note: High-value but management- and water-sensitive option; market-price ranking must be dynamic.
algorithm_use_note: Use first-week-November as optimum, not as a hard final planting deadline. A broader late window needs Rajshahi-specific validation before MISSED logic.
research_notes: A recent central-Bangladesh dataset also shows BARI Alu-41 responses across 20 Nov-20 Dec plantings, but those later dates are not inserted as Rajshahi-recommended endpoints.
